title: Normalize user room-code input without generating security tokens
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Implement normalizeRoomCode exactly as frozen in section B082 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Accept a string, trim outer whitespace and uppercase ASCII a–z only, then require exactly six ASCII A–Z/0–9 characters per the existing room-code baseline. acceptance: Six-character lowercase/uppercase/mixed ASCII codes normalize deterministically with outer whitespace removed.
Five/seven characters, interior spaces, confusable fullwidth letters and punctuation reject.
Nonstring/accessor objects never invoke conversion; errors do not echo potential passcodes and no RNG/credential state is touched.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.
